# QTI Protocol Pull Request Template

Thank you for contributing to the QTI Protocol specifications. This template is designed to keep changes auditable and institutionally readable.

## Summary

- [ ] Briefly describe the purpose of this PR
- [ ] Indicate which version(s) are affected (v1 / v2 / v3 / v4)

## Change Type

- [ ] Documentation only (spec wording, structure)
- [ ] Economic model change
- [ ] Governance / emissions change
- [ ] Risk / testing change
- [ ] Other (describe)

## Detailed Description

- What is changing in the specification?
- Why is this change necessary now?
- How does it impact existing deployments or validation gates?

## Validation

- [ ] All relevant tests updated (unit / integration / invariants)
- [ ] Validation gates updated where necessary
- [ ] Backwards-compatibility evaluated and documented

## Risks & Mitigations

- Enumerate any new risks introduced by this change
- Describe the mitigations and how they will be enforced

## Governance / Ops Notes

- If governance is affected, describe the proposal path
- If operations are affected (monitoring, incident response), describe the required updates
